_comment: Worked example: RAIN's 11 source systems mapped to the upper ontology by this skill. This is what a real run's output looks like -- generic nodes/edges, not tied to any one client's table names. Load straight into Neo4j (or Cosmos Gremlin / Fabric graph, whichever gets chosen) as-is.

concepts.name: Constituent
concepts.definition: The person or entity the whole system is organized around, tracked across any clinical, claims, financial, or operational system. Domain-specific systems may label this 'Patient' (healthcare), 'Member' (financial services), etc. -- those are specializations of this one concept, not separate concepts.
concepts.renamed_from: C-PATIENT (was healthcare-flavored; generalized after the USSFCU genericity test surfaced the bias -- see ussfcu-genericity-test.json)

concepts.name: Provider
concepts.definition: A clinician or care team member responsible for a patient's care.

concepts.name: Care Episode
concepts.definition: A bounded period of care for a specific condition or event (e.g. a pregnancy, a chronic-condition enrollment).

concepts.name: Risk Signal
concepts.definition: A computed or observed indicator that a patient's risk has changed (an RPM reading trend, a missed visit, a lab overdue).

concepts.name: Access Barrier
concepts.definition: A structural obstacle to care -- distance, transportation, connectivity, or provider availability.

mappings.note: field name differs from other sources -- flagged, not auto-merged
plausible but not certain -- needs human review before merge

duplicate_candidates.resolution: not a duplicate -- distinct concepts, kept separate

coverage_gaps_detected.description: A constituent can hold both a Care Episode (pregnancy) and a separate Care Episode (chronic condition) with no explicit link between them, even though both trace to the same person.
coverage_gaps_detected.impact: Cross-episode risk questions (e.g. 'pregnancy risk cross-referenced with chronic conditions') return incomplete results without an explicit join concept.
coverage_gaps_detected.recommendation: Add a 'Compounding Risk' relationship type between two Care Episode nodes sharing a Constituent, rather than relying on the calling application to infer it.
